description_en: Queries the classification nodes in the data classification and grading feature of Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用QuerySensClassification接口，查询数据保护伞分类分级中的分类节点
name: QuerySensClassification

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the template defined by Data Security Guard. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html operation.

The QueryDefaultTemplate operation may return an empty array. In this case, view the ID of the configured data classification and grading template in the Data Security Guard console, or contact the DataWorks administrator for confirmation
parameters.help_zh:
数据保护伞定义的模板ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html接口获取。

QueryDefaultTemplate 可能返回空数组；此时请在数据保护伞控制台查看已配置的分类分级模板 ID，或联系 DataWorks 管理员确认
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the Data Studio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and choose Menu > User Info to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

Data.description_en: The information about the classification nodes in the data classification and grading feature of Data Security Guard. The value is in JSON format
Data.description_zh: 返回的数据保护伞分类分级中的分类节点信息。JSON格式

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
